_note: Frames for subframe_audit.py. A frame is COMPLETE only when its county list is enumerated, either inline as `fips` or in a `fips_file` that exists. A frame defined by `states` alone is PROVISIONAL: the audit still runs and still finds gaps, but its recall is a state-aggregate proxy for the frame and must not be quoted as the frame's recall in a client deliverable. Every frame needs `provenance` naming where the county list came from.

tva.name: TVA region county brief
tva.provenance: 198-county frame used for the TVA-region deliverable, 2026-08. The county list itself was assembled outside the repo and has not been committed; until configs/frames/tva_198_counties.csv exists with one fips per row, this frame resolves to all counties in the seven listed states and reports as provisional.
tva.notes: This is the frame whose manual cross-check found Hawkins, Hamilton, Grundy, Coffee and Walker. It is registered here so the same check is a command rather than an analyst remembering to do it.

vantage_three_state.name: Vantage first client order
vantage_three_state.provenance: The three scored sites in the first Vantage order: Arapahoe County CO (Aurora), Wyandotte County KS (Kansas City), Powhatan County VA. County list is exhaustive by construction.
vantage_three_state.notes: Kansas is the thinnest of the three states on coverage, so re-run this frame before any refresh of the scored assessments.
